result.topic_en: Draft discussion of a continuity condition for a function γ near a point (with sin(1/ρ) as a counterexample with infinitely many maxima and minima) and its use to show that an integral of (γ1−γ2)^2 κ ds / (log(1−κp2) − log(1−κp1)) exceeds any bound C; ends with a definition of one surface being a (continuous) image of another.
